questions.stem_text: Explain the mechanism of the genetic determination of sex in man .

options.A: The temperature during embryonic development determines the sex.
options.B: The presence of an X or Y chromosome in the mother determines the sex of the offspring.
options.C: The presence of the X chromosome determines the sex.
options.D: The sex is determined by environmental factors after birth.
options.E: The presence of two Y chromosomes determines that an individual will be male.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The temperature during embryonic development determines the sex.

questions.stem_text: What unusual feature of the cycads makes them are remarkable group among the seed plants?

options.A: They have flowers that bloom for several years before producing seeds
options.B: They have a unique leaf structure
options.C: They can survive in extremely cold climates
options.E: Their seeds can remain dormant for up to a century before germinating

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - They have flowers that bloom for several years before producing seeds

Is the advanced age a contraindication to GERD laparoscopic surgery?
questions.answer_explanation: Laparoscopic antireflux surgery is a safe and effective treatment for GERD even in elderly patients, warranting low morbidity and mortality rates and a significant improvement of symptoms comparable to younger patients.

questions.stem_text: Should ascitis volume and anthropometric measurements be estimated in hospitalized alcoholic cirrotics?
questions.answer_explanation: A greater association than hitherto acknowledged, between ascitis volume and anthropometric measurements from one side, and long-term rehospitalization and mortality from the other, was demonstrated in male stable alcoholic cirrhotics. Further studies with alcoholic and other modalities of cirrhosis including women are recommended.

questions.stem_text: Perioperative care in an animal model for training in abdominal surgery: is it necessary a preoperative fasting?
questions.answer_explanation: The rabbit is a good model to be used in training of surgery, with a low morbi-mortality, able to be anesthetized intramuscularly, with no need of pre-operative fasting and does not present hypoglycemia even with the extended fasting period.

questions.stem_text: Does Sensation Return to the Nasal Tip After Microfat Grafting?
questions.answer_explanation: Postoperative numbness occurs in most patients receiving nasal microfat injections. Partial to complete recovery of nasal tip sensation can be expected to occur over a 3-month period.

questions.stem_text: Is fetal anatomic assessment on follow-up antepartum sonograms clinically useful?
questions.answer_explanation: A fetal anatomic survey on follow-up sonograms may identify unanticipated fetal anomalies, especially when the indication is for fetal growth.
